proc main (): eff loaded integer :=
  let strong x: pointer = create(Ivalignof('signed int'), 'signed int') in
  let strong a_507: loaded integer = bound(pure(Specified(5))) in
  store('signed int', x, conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_507)) ;
  let strong a_509: loaded integer =
    bound(
      let weak (a_511: loaded integer, a_512: loaded integer) =
        unseq(
          let weak (a_517: loaded integer, a_518: loaded integer) =
            unseq(
              let weak a_516: pointer = pure(x) in
              load('signed int', a_516)
            ,
              pure(Specified(3))
            ) in
          case (a_517, a_518) of
            | (Specified(a_519: integer), Specified(a_520: integer)) =>
                pure(
                  if conv_int('signed int', a_519) >
                  conv_int('signed int', a_520) then
                    Specified(1)
                  else
                    Specified(0)
                )
            | _: (loaded integer,loaded integer) =>
                pure(Unspecified('signed int'))
          end
        ,
          pure(Specified(0))
        ) in
      pure(
        case (a_511, a_512) of
          | (Specified(a_513: integer), Specified(a_514: integer)) =>
              if conv_int('signed int', a_513) = conv_int('signed int', a_514) then
                Specified(1)
              else
                Specified(0)
          | _: (loaded integer,loaded integer) =>
              Unspecified('signed int')
        end
      )
    ) in
  let strong a_508: boolean =
    case a_509 of
      | Specified(a_510: integer) =>
          pure(if not(a_510 = 1) then True else False)
      | Unspecified(_: ctype) =>
          nd(pure(True), pure(False))
    end in
  if a_508 then
    let strong a_522: loaded integer = bound(pure(Specified(1))) in
    kill('signed int', x) ;
    run ret_506(conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_522)) ;
    pure(Unit)
  else
    let strong a_523: loaded integer = bound(pure(Specified(0))) in
    kill('signed int', x) ;
    run ret_506(conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_523)) ;
    pure(Unit) ;
  kill('signed int', x) ;
  pure(Unit) ;
  save ret_506: loaded integer (a_524: loaded integer:= Specified(0)) in
    pure(a_524)
